description: This file defines a PHP class 'Memcached' that provides a wrapper around the PHP Memcached extension for caching purposes within the OpenCart system. It includes methods for getting, setting, and deleting cache entries, and manages a Memcached connection.

classes.name: Memcached
classes.description: A class that provides a wrapper around the PHP Memcached extension, managing cache operations with configurable expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Memcached wrapper, creating a new Memcached connection and adding a server using predefined constants.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value associated with a key, prepending a prefix.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiration time, defaulting to the class setting.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached entry by key.
